Future steps: 
Despite a community call discussion that was held last week to continue the experiment for another year, we feel that the Diversification Fund should be shut down and the assets be either held in the DAO treasury or liquidated to stable and held in the DAO treasury. We made this decision after a lot of thought, as our ability to properly steward the experiment will diminish due to increasing commitments of time in our respective jobs and projects. 

We believe that we have accomplished what we set out to do in the experiment in exploring the idea of assets being trusted to a subgroup of individuals in the DAO and helping manage the treasury, while continuing on the educational mission of learning more about the respective ecosystems, markets and industry as a whole. Furthermore we are extremely grateful to the community for allowing us to conduct this experiment with special thanks to Shankar, Thom and Zovern for continuing to engage and support each of us and the experiment with input and guidance. 

Thank you.

## EDG | Diversification Fund - May/June 2022 Update


Date: 15-07-22
Advisor council: Advait Rane, Vismay Joshi, ash|inthewild 
Metrics & KPI’s
- Revenue: -$2420 (-21%)
- Expenses: $0K 
- Ecosystem Allocations (Ethereum - 18%, Stable holdings - 78%): 

![](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/NbVyJnh5lY4KO7zaL5NvdgOpMXXFUdwinkFYXIO0fZWtfS0MJhuYpddppspKNz_-TrjfbGpNez6navCTw-PoM3ZqW7L7cDIhCOJfaKAvqRaygvxLJWBGjjavYf40x7463RROtNx66QXMD1_8UDxRUg)
- Cash in Fund: $8936


**General updates: **
The Diversification Fund (DF) has now been active for two months since the dispersion of funds to the Financial WG multisig wallet (Proposal 54 on Commonwealth - subscan link: [https://edgeware.subscan.io/treasury/54](https://edgeware.subscan.io/treasury/54)). Since the last monthly report, we can see that the macro trend across traditional markets and crypto markets has been glum, with large flows of capital being pulled out or liquidated. Specifically in cryptomarkets the when the DF update report was released (5-3-22) BTC has slipped further as the Advisory Council has hypothesized. 
During this time we have also seen some large implosions, particularly in CeFi (Celsius, Voyager), ecosystem / projects (Terra, Anchor) and cryptonative VC / Prop Fund(3AC). 
Overall we still feel that ‘the other Cypherkick’ is yet to drop…That is we specifically feel that at the time this report is being written BTC’s price of $19,746.79 is still higher than what we feel is the real value (based on current market conditions).The price should / will be lower in upcoming weeks and will affect all other token prices in the industry.

 
**Fund updates + strategy: **

Since receiving the EDG, we have taken some positions into the respective ecosystem’s w/ specific dapp exposure predominately to DeFi & metaverse within Ethereum. The remaining funds have been allocated to stablecoin. While we originally maintained the non allocated funds in USDT, the Advisory Council feels that USDT might not be as stable as it seems in light of recent events; we have opted not to store the funds in the USDC as well as we are concerned about contagion risks from Voyager and other macro trends that could place their respective underlying collateral further along the risk spectrum in the current market condition. Hence we currently storing the remaining assets in BUSD 

![](https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/B4B5rzGjmkQM9EsFeTbEvxAEhvoWDYi89h5Nm-EBfIeX6HvhiEMOFmyOze03JjPdbG_qUL1uTUaJ1coYaW3upYBztlUqYIjm7P_-eWWg50_w7p5sSOwvD8MWMU9N-iIzmVUJxICodox31o_9MLQRzY0)

While the market is depressed and we still will further trend downwards,The Advisory council still feels confident on the respective ecosystems, Ethereum Polkadot, Cosmos and the overall ecosystem allocation strategy (ETH - 40%, DOT - 20%, ATOM - 30%); however we are reconsidering allocation weighting to specific project types (DeFi, Gaming, Meta, Infra.) within each sector. 

**Notable Events**: 

1. The downfall of Terra / luna, Anchor and its ‘mini-ecosystem’ within Cosmos has created the possibility of a reboot, Terra 2.0; shortly after launch however the new project has seen a dramatic decline in token price. 
2. 3AC (3 arrow’s capital) large VC and prop trading firm that is filing for bankruptcy
3. The contagion of 3AC being insolvent has spread into
4. Celsius (CeFi - collateralized lending) 
5. Voyager digital (CeFi- digital asset brokerage) 


It is also to be noted that there could be some risk with sETH (LIDO) as well as 3AC holdings and as such we are NOT interested in supporting staking derivatives until the Advisory Council understands 2nd or 3rd order risks associated with such products.
